name: status-03
description: An active incident with its severity, affected components and a timeline of updates.

files.content:
'use client' import { ActivityFeed, ActivityFeedItem, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/activity-feed' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { StatusIndicator, type StatusLevel, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/status' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface IncidentUpdate { message: string stage: 'Investigating' | 'Identified' | 'Monitoring' | 'Resolved' time: string } interface Status3Props { affected: string[] onSubscribe?: () => void severity: StatusLevel started: string status?: BlockStatus title: string /** Newest first. Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ updates?: IncidentUpdate[] } const exampleProps: Status3Props = { affected: ['API', 'Webhooks'], severity: 'partial', started: 'Started today at 14:02 UTC', title: 'Elevated API error rates', updates: [ { message: 'A fix has been deployed and error rates are back to normal. We are monitoring the results.', stage: 'Monitoring', time: '14:40 UTC', }, { message: 'We traced the errors to a misconfigured load balancer in us-east-1 and are rolling back.', stage: 'Identified', time: '14:18 UTC', }, { message: 'We are investigating increased 5xx responses on API requests.', stage: 'Investigating', time: '14:05 UTC', }, ], } const listFormat = new Intl.ListFormat('en-US', { type: 'conjunction' }) const Status3 = (props: Status3Props) => { const { affected, onSubscribe, severity, started, status, title, updates = [] } = props const state = getBlockState(status, updates.length === 0) return (

{title}

{[ started, affected.length > 0 && `Affects ${listFormat.format(affected)}`, ] .filter(Boolean) .map((sentence) => `${sentence}.`) .join(' ')}

{state && (
)} {!state && ( {updates.map((update, index) => (

{update.stage} {update.time}

{update.message}

))} )}
) } export { Status3, exampleProps as status3ExampleProps, type Status3Props }
